items.title: Norman Brownlee Interview, 1961-05-05
items.q: And they all came in. They came up. We were staying at the Claridge Hotel there in Memphis. And they all came through.

ctx.x: I forget his first name. Harry, I think it was. Yeah. Harry Goodman. And they all came in. They came up. We were staying at the Claridge Hotel there in Memphis. And they all came through. They had had thirteen mules on the way from the west coast coming over trying to get back to New York.
